battle.name: 王子英起義
battle.brief: 隋大業十三年（617），潞州鄉人王子英聚眾反隋，攻陷上黨州城，義軍眾數史載不詳，或云數萬，是隋末北方民變中較早的一場。隋廷以郡兵、州兵與輕騎討平，戰事不足數月。州城攻防之中，秦弩是守方壓制攻城者的主力，弩機存力、矢程遠過弓，弩手列陣城頭，把密集攻城的鄉兵壓在牆外。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 王子英起義發生在隋大業十三年（617）的北方亂局之中，交戰的兩方一邊是起兵反隋的潞州鄉人，一邊是隋朝的州郡官府與中央派來的鎮壓軍隊。叛方並非割據一方的政權，而是以鄉里為基礎臨時聚合的武裝：主體是受過兵役的鄉兵、裁汰的府兵與逃戶、散卒，核心人物王子英是潞州本地人，據史籍記載由他首倡聚眾，攻破州治上黨城之後控制潞州一帶數縣，一度開府庫、取糧械、招納郡兵。正方是隋朝在潞州的統治機構：州刺史掌一州軍政，郡丞、縣令各守其地，兵源是文帝開皇年間設置的郡兵與州兵，另有中央調發的虎賁、驍騎配合地方郡兵作戰。值得注意的是，此時隋朝的實際控制力只及於城鎮與交通線，廣袤鄉里幾乎全靠地方武裝維持，而郡兵久欠糧餉、逃亡散失，遇上有人振臂一呼便迅速崩解。同年北方還有竇建德在河北稱夏王、劉黑悶在河北再起、杜伏威在江淮、瓦崗翟讓李密在河南、朔方梁師都在西北，潞州之變雖小，卻是這張反隋網上最早爆開的幾個結之一。
countriesEn: Prince Ziying's rising broke out in 617 CE, amid the collapse of Sui authority in the north. The two sides were, on one hand, the villagers of Luzhou who rose against the dynasty, and on the other the Sui prefectural and commandery administrations together with the troops sent to suppress them. The insurgents were not a state with its own territory: they were a hastily assembled armed body drawn from the local militia, discharged and deserting palace troops, fugitive households and scattered soldiers, with the local man Prince Ziying as the man who first called them together. Once the prefectural seat of Shangdang was taken they controlled several counties around Luzhou, opened the treasury, seized grain and weapons, and absorbed parts of the commandery militia. The Sui side consisted of the governor of the prefecture, the commandery assistant officials and the district magistrates, drawing their fighting men from the commandery militias instituted under Emperor Wen and supplemented by the palace guards and elite cavalry dispatched from the centre. Crucially, Sui control in 617 reached the cities and the roads; the countryside was held together by local levies whose pay had been in arrears for years, whose weapons had rotted and whose ranks kept dissolving. In the same year Dou Jiande proclaimed himself King of Xia in Hebei, Liu Heichong rose again in Hebei, Du Fuwei campaigned in the Jianghuai, the Wagang leaders Zhai Rang and Li Mi operated in Henan, and Liang Shidu held Shufang in the far north. The Luzhou revolt was small, yet it was one of the earliest knots to burst open in that web of revolt.
people: 起義的核心人物是王子英，但關於他本人的記載極為稀少，可確定者僅有三點：他是潞州鄉人，在大業十三年五月前後聚眾反隋，攻陷上黨州城，並且在短時間內成為這支武裝的實際首領；其生平、籍貫、年齡與出身，通行史籍均未留下詳細交代，諸說並存，後世史家也僅能依上下文推斷他大概是當地鄉里中的小康自耕農或小吏出身。起義集團內部的其他首領與參與者，史料多略去不書，只以「眾」概括；僅隱約提到部眾之間曾因推舉首領而有所分歧，而這一說法同樣未見文獻確證。隋方的記載也一樣殘缺：州刺史的名字不見於史，僅記其為義軍所殺或被逐出州城；郡丞、縣令與郡兵將佐的姓名同樣闕如；中央派來或由郡自行彙集的討伐軍統帥，在史籍中多略作「遣軍討之」一語。與他同在一年的北方起義首領則清楚得多：竇建德在河北建號夏王，翟讓與李密在瓦崗聚眾，劉黑悶在河北再起，杜伏威轉戰江淮，梁師都據朔方；洛陽一線由王世充等守臣主持應變，而隋煬帝已遠在江都，號令不能及於河北山東。潞州之變正是在這樣的權力真空裡發生。
peopleEn: Prince Ziying is the central figure, and what survives about him is very thin: he was a native of Luzhou, he raised an armed band in the months around the fifth month of the Daye thirteenth year (617), he stormed the prefectural seat of Shangdang, and within a short time he was the effective leader of the movement. His biography, origin, age and station are not recorded in any surviving history, and later scholars can only infer from context that he was probably a middling landholder or minor functionary in the local community. The names of his fellow leaders and of those who followed him are almost never given; the sources simply speak of the multitude, and the suggestion that the band quarrelled over who should lead appears only as a rumour that no document confirms. The Sui side is described just as thinly: the name of the prefect does not appear, only the statement that he was killed by the insurgents or driven out of the city; the names of the commandery assistant, the district magistrate and the officers of the militia are likewise missing; and the commander of the punitive force is generally reduced to a single formula, an army was sent to punish them. By contrast the leaders of the northern risings of the same year are named clearly enough: Dou Jiande in Hebei, Zhai Rang and Li Mi at Wagang, Liu Heichong again in Hebei, Du Fuwei in the Jianghuai and Liang Shidu at Shufang. In Luoyang the capital region was held by officials such as Wang Shichong, while the Sui emperor had already moved away to Jiangdu, so that orders could no longer reach Hebei and Shandong. The Luzhou revolt took shape in exactly this vacuum of power.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩在隋末的兵器體系裡，屬於守城與野戰都靠得住的單兵投射兵器：弩機把拉力存住，上弦一次可待數箭，射手只須扣機，故射程遠過手弓，射速又遠過需要重張的角弓；史家形容守城一方正是靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。此役的兵器結構大致可以分成三層。起義的鄉兵多無甲，兵器以弓、環首刀、長矛為主，攻城時只能靠臨時製作的雲梯、木梯、穴進的地道以及撞擊城門的粗大木柱，另有一些改製的農具與自製的火箭，用途是燒毀城門與糧堆而非攻擊城頭守軍；他們從郡兵手中繳獲的弩數量有限，多半壞損、缺弦或沒有合用的弩機。守城與隨後討伐的官軍則完全是另一個檔次：城頭及城外列陣的是成建制的弩手，弩機有銅製與木製之分，射手分為前排立弩、後排上弦的輪番配置，發矢齊整而遠程精確；步卒持長矛、環首刀與楯，著明光鎧或兩當鎧；輕騎與精騎在兩翼奔馳，射馬用角弓；攻城則動用撞車、巢車與拋石這類大型器械，隋軍征高句麗時用過拋石與巢車，記錄裡有載。整體看，義軍在投射火力、攻城器械與護甲三方面都全面落後，唯一能與官軍抗衡的，是熟悉地形與熟悉鄉里道路。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card belongs to the family of single-man missile weapons that stayed dependable both in defence and in the field. The trigger mechanism stores the draw of the bow, so a loaded crossbow waits on its trigger for several shots and the archer only has to work the lever; its range therefore exceeds that of a hand bow, while its rate of fire is far below that of a recurved cavalry bow which has to be re-drawn each time. It is precisely this quality that let the defenders of a walled town keep the men climbing at bay. The arms on show in this rising fall into three layers. The village band was mostly unarmoured and carried bows, ring-pommel sabres, spears and improvised tools, with scaling ladders, timber posts for battering the gates, tunnels driven under the walls and a few homemade fire arrows whose purpose was to burn gates and grain stacks rather than to strike the defenders on the wall; the crossbows they took from the militia were few, often broken, unstrung or missing a serviceable lock. The garrison that defended the city, and the punitive columns that followed, belonged to a different order of equipment altogether: formed bodies of crossbowmen, some with bronze and some with wooden locks, drawn up with the front rank holding the weapons ready and the rear rank stringing, delivering volleys that were both long-ranged and regular; infantry with long spears, ring-pommel sabres and shields, wearing light or lamellar armour; light and heavy cavalry working the flanks with horn bows for shooting at horse; and, for the attack on the walls, battering rams, scaling towers and stone-throwers of the kind Sui armies had used against Goguryeo. In crossbows, armour and siege equipment alike the insurgents were outclassed; their only real advantage was their familiarity with the ground and the roads of their own countryside.
tactics: 起義方的戰術帶有典型的鄉民暴動特徵：先在村社之中以口頭號令集合，選夜裡或晨昏守備鬆弛之際突然發難，或因內應而開城門；入城之後搶救府庫、散糧給饑民，再分兵出掠鄰縣、收編散在鄉里的郡兵與亡命，把局面從一座州城擴大到盆地幾個縣。這種打法依靠的是人多、熟悉道路與出其不意，而不是任何技術上的精巧；義軍沒有遠程攻城器械，也缺乏攻城的實際經驗，一旦官軍主力抵達城下，攻守便立刻逆轉。隋廷的應對則是標準的鎮壓程式：先令鄰郡戒嚴、封鎖通往州城的幾條大道與渡口，斷絕城外的糧秣與援兵通道，逼義軍不得不在城內枯守或出城野戰；同時在城外遠處布設弩陣，以弩機的射程覆蓋城郊的集結地與田禾之間的空地，讓義軍無法安全地列陣出擊；步卒持楯、護著撞車與雲梯逼近城牆，準備攻門或架梯；騎兵則在兩翼巡弋，專等義軍潰散時衝入分割；最後才是分兵斷糧、勸降、離間，攻心與攻力並行。秦弩在這一整套程序中的位置很明確：城頭上的弩手把雲梯頂住牆外，郊外的弩陣把援兵與糧車擋在射程之外，它們不負責破門破城，卻決定了誰能把兵投送到門下。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the insurgents belong to the classic pattern of a peasant rising: men gathered by word of mouth in the villages, then moved suddenly at night or in the grey hours before dawn when the watch was slack, or entered the city through a door opened by insiders. Once inside they seized the treasury, distributed grain to the hungry, then sent bands out to strip the neighbouring districts, absorb the militia men and fugitives scattered over the countryside, and widen the revolt from one prefectural city to several counties of the basin. The strength of this method lay in numbers, in local knowledge of the roads and in surprise, not in any technical refinement; the insurgents had no long-range siege equipment and no real experience of taking walls, so once the Sui main force reached the city the roles of attacker and defender reversed at once. The court's response followed the standard pattern of suppression: the neighbouring prefectures were put on alert and the main roads and fords leading to the city were sealed, cutting off food and any relief so that the rebels were forced either to rot inside the walls or to come out and fight in the open; crossbow lines were then set up at a distance beyond the city, covering the open ground and the fields where the insurgents had been assembling and denying them a safe place to form up; infantry with shields covered the battering rams and scaling ladders as they closed on the wall; cavalry worked both flanks, waiting for the moment the insurgents broke and then charging into them; and only alongside the assault came the business of cutting supplies, offering terms and sowing division. The crossbow had a precise place in this sequence. The crossbowmen on the wall held the scaling ladders against the outer face; the crossbow line outside kept relief columns and supply carts out of range. They did not break the gate, but they decided who could bring troops to it.
data: 可用的數字並不多，以下幾項相對可靠。這場起義發生在隋大業十三年，即公元617年，大業年號始於605年，時已十三年。背景數字：隋軍征高句麗三次，集中在612、613、614年，每次出征的役夫與士卒規模以百萬計，這雖不是本役的數字，卻是理解亂局的關鍵；617年前後，全國先後出現數十處起義據點，北方尤為密集。地理數字：潞州治上黨城，在今山西長治一帶，位於上黨盆地之中，東倚太行，南臨沁漳，西接霍太，北通壺關，是關中與河北之間的孔道；自上黨至東都洛陽，直線距離約三百餘里，隋制驍騎急遞亦需數日，故中央的指令與援軍到達總是滯後。兵員方面，義軍眾數史無可靠記載，僅有「或云數萬」一類的概說，實際可能自數千至數萬不等，諸說並存；隋方投入的則是郡兵、州兵與輕騎的混合支隊，郡兵依制以若干人編為旅、團，細節各書不一，駐州守軍的實際人數應在數百上下。兵器數據方面，弩的有效射程一般說在百步上下，重新上弦需數息，弩手每分鐘只能發射數發，而弓手可發數十發；弩的價值在於把射手從拉弓的瞬間用力中解放出來，瞄準與齊射的質量遠高於弓。
dataEn: The usable figures are few, and the following are the more reliable ones. The rising belongs to the Daye thirteenth year of the Sui dynasty, that is 617 CE; the Daye era began in 605, so this was the thirteenth year of it. The background figures: the Sui court campaigned against Goguryeo three times, in 612, 613 and 614, each time mustering a force and its corvée labour on a scale measured in hundreds of thousands, which is not a figure belonging to this rising but is the key to understanding the situation. By 617 some several dozen centres of revolt had appeared across the empire, densest in the north. Geography: Luzhou was administered from the city of Shangdang, in the area of present-day Changzhi in Shanxi, set in the Shangdang basin, with the Taihang range to the east, the Qin and Zhang rivers to the south, the Huo mountain range to the west and the Hanguan corridor to the north, the short road between Guanzhong and Hebei; the straight-line distance from Shangdang to the eastern capital Luoyang was a little over three hundred li, and even Sui elite cavalry needed several days to cover it, so central orders and reinforcements always arrived late. On the strength of the insurgents, no reliable number exists; there are only general statements to the effect that there were perhaps tens of thousands, while the real figure may have been anywhere from a few thousand to tens of thousands, and the accounts differ. On the Sui side the force was a mixed column of commandery militia, prefectural soldiers and light cavalry, the militia being organised in units of several hundred, though the details differ from book to book, and the actual garrison of the city was probably in the order of several hundred men. On the weapons, the effective range of a crossbow is generally put at around a hundred paces, re-stringing takes several breaths, so a crossbowman can loose only a few shots a minute against the dozens a bowman can manage; the value of the crossbow lay in freeing the shooter from the effort of drawing, which gave far better aim and far better volleys than a plain bow.
cause: 王子英起義的直接起因，是隋朝統治在潞州的崩解。隋自612年起三次征討高句麗，兵役、徭役與轉運之征同時壓在百姓身上，男子被徵入軍籍、離家遠役，糧食與布帛年年加派；州縣官吏趁急徵之際加強括戶、括丁與雜稅，州刺史與郡丞的催逼更為急迫，鄉里之間流傳的「上者盡力征求，下者傾家蕩產」一類怨言，反映的正是基層的實感。更直接的一層，是郡兵制度的崩壞：開皇年間設置的郡兵名義上是地方常備武備，到大業年間已長期欠糧、缺器、逃亡，兵器腐蝕而無從修補，軍籍與戶籍分離，逃戶不能復業，於是同一批人既被官吏當作可以隨時徵調的兵源，又被當作可以隨時棄置的負擔。潞州恰在要衝，商旅、漕運與軍需都經過此道，徵發的密度遠高於一般州縣；而在隋末那種謠言、讖語與妖言盛行的空氣下，一句「天下當亂」的預言、一位鄉人的號召，就足以把散亂的怨恨集合成兵。617年河北的竇建德、劉黑悶與河南瓦崗的翟讓、李密已先後舉兵，北方反隋的骨架在那一年成型，王子英之變是這張網在山西東南部撕開的第一個口子。
causeEn: The immediate cause of Prince Ziying's rising was the breakdown of Sui government in Luzhou. Since 612 the court had waged three campaigns against Goguryeo, and the military levies, the corvée labour and the transport duties were all laid on the people at the same time: men were taken into the army rolls and sent far from home, grain and cloth were levied every year, and the officials of the prefectures and commanderies, taking advantage of the emergency, pushed the registration of households and of taxable adults and the miscellaneous levies harder than ever. The sense of the countryside is preserved in a widely repeated saying of the time: those above strained every nerve to extract, those below emptied their homes and possessions. A more immediate layer was the decay of the militia system. The commandery levies set up in the Kaihuang era were nominally standing local troops, but by the Daye years their pay was chronically in arrears, their arms were rotten and beyond repair, and the military rolls were divorced from the household registers, so that the same men were treated by the officials both as a source of troops that could be summoned at any time and as a burden that could be dropped at any time. Luzhou stood on a trunk road, so commerce, river transport and military supply all passed through it, and the density of requisitioning was far higher there than in an ordinary prefecture. In an atmosphere thick with rumour, prophecy and the pretensions of false saints, a single prediction that the world would fall into disorder and a single local man's shout was enough to gather scattered resentment into an army. In 617 Dou Jiande and Liu Heichong had already risen in Hebei and Zhai Rang and Li Mi had gathered at Wagang in Henan; the skeleton of the northern revolt was already in place when Prince Ziying's rising tore the first breach in it in south-eastern Shanxi.
impact: 起義很快被壓平，但它造成的幾個後果並不短暫。第一，郡兵體系的信用被公開證偽：隋廷發現可以倚賴的只有城牆、府庫與中央直屬的少量精騎，廣袤鄉里一旦有人起事就無力迅速平復，此後對民變只能靠從別處抽調郡兵、加速中央軍隊的消耗。第二，義軍的殘部與散兵沒有消失，而是沿著山道流向河北與河南：往北投竇建德、劉黑悶，往東入瓦崗李密之軍，往西則有散卒捲入關中與山西北部的亂局，於是山西、河南、河北三地的反隋武裝被連成一條可以互相呼應的線，隋廷再也無法把它們分開各個擊破。第三，潞州與上黨的戰略價值在亂局中被放大：這條貫穿太行的通道是關中進入河北的捷徑，隋亡之後成為李淵、李世民父子與劉武周、宋金剛在北方爭奪的同一條路線，李元吉以並州為基地經營河北，薛仁貴與秦瓊等將領往來於並潞之間，都以這一帶為依託。第四，兵員結構在亂局中重組：郡兵潰散後，府兵與募兵混編，各割據政權競相招納亡散之卒，弩手、騎射之屬的技術型兵種在唐初編制中被重新編排，為唐代早期軍制的變化埋下伏筆。
impactEn: The rising was crushed quickly, but several of its consequences were not short-lived. First, the credit of the militia system was publicly disproved: the court found that what it could still rely on was its walls, its treasuries and a small number of centrally controlled cavalry, while the countryside, once someone rose, could not be brought back under control quickly; from then on the only answer to revolt was to strip commandery militias from one region and send them to another, which consumed the central armies faster. Second, the rebels' remnants and scattered men did not disappear: they moved along the mountain roads towards Hebei and Henan, north to Dou Jiande and Liu Heichong, east to Li Mi's Wagang army, and west into the disorder of Guanzhong and northern Shanxi, so that the anti-Sui armed bands of Shanxi, Henan and Hebei were strung into a single line that could call on one another, and the court could no longer defeat them separately. Third, the strategic value of Luzhou and Shangdang grew as the situation worsened: the corridor through the Taihang was the short road from Guanzhong into Hebei, and after the fall of the Sui it became the very road contested by Li Yuan and his sons and by Liu Wuzhou and Song Jingang in the north; Li Yuanji, operating from Bingzhou, built his Hebei position on it, and generals such as Xue Rengui and Qin Qiong moved between Bing and Lu, leaning on this line throughout. Fourth, the composition of the forces was recast: once the militias dissolved, palace troops and recruited soldiers were mixed together, every regime competed for the deserters, and the technically demanding trades, crossbowmen and mounted archers, were reorganised in the early Tang order of battle, foreshadowing changes in Tang military institutions.
result: 結果是起義被平定，隋朝的州郡秩序在潞州恢復，但恢復的只是表面。討伐軍進抵上黨後，義軍或死於攻城的雲梯之下，或在野戰中被騎兵衝散，王子英本人的下落史無明文，或云戰歿，或云為部眾所害，或云趁亂逃散，諸說並存。郡兵重新登記造冊，繳獲的弩、弓與雜兵器入庫，府庫中散出去的糧食重新收集，州刺史與郡丞或復職或改派，潞州一帶短暫回到朝廷控制之下；部分散兵則帶著繳獲的弩與甲轉投竇建德、劉黑悶與瓦崗軍，把這場起義留下的裝備與經驗帶進了別的戰場。從全局看，這場戰爭的規模、延續時間與史料留存的細節都極為有限，多數史籍對它只有數語記載，戰果數字亦無從核實，因此它的價值更多在於提供一個標本：它顯示出隋朝在617年已經只剩下城防與器械之利，而失去鄉里之間的兵與糧。正是同一年全域的崩解，導致次年（618）隋室覆亡、割據者競相爭奪上黨，而那條太行孔道上的第一場反隋戰火，正是從潞州這座州城燒起來的。
resultEn: The outcome was that the rising was put down and the Sui administrative order was restored in Luzhou, though only on the surface. When the punitive columns reached Shangdang the insurgents were either killed under the scaling ladders or scattered by cavalry in the field; Prince Ziying's own fate is not clearly recorded, some accounts have him falling in the fighting, others have him killed by his own men, others have him escaping into the countryside as the bands dispersed, and the accounts differ. The militia was enrolled afresh, the crossbows, bows and odds of arms that had been captured went back into the stores, the grain let out of the treasury was collected again, the prefect and the commandery assistant were restored to office or replaced, and for a while Luzhou was once more under the court's control; some of the scattered men, however, carried the crossbows and armour they had taken into the armies of Dou Jiande, Liu Heichong and the Wagang host, bringing the equipment and the lessons of this rising into other battlefields. Judged as a whole, the scale, the duration and the surviving detail of this war are all extremely limited, most histories give it only a few lines, and the figures for its results cannot be checked, so its value lies mainly in providing a specimen: it showed that by 617 the Sui retained only the advantages of walls and missiles and had lost the soldiers and the grain of the countryside. It was the collapse across the board in that same year that brought the fall of the Sui in 618 and the scramble for Shangdang among the regional powers, and the first anti-Sui fighting on that Taihang road began, in a sense, with the smoke rising from the city of Luzhou.
